_readme: The tracks. Every track is an oval: two straights joined by two half-circle bends, run anticlockwise. straight = length of each straight in metres. radius = radius of the bends in metres (smaller is tighter). finishBeforeBend = how far the finish line is before bend 1. distances = the race distances this track stages, in metres, by kind of race: sprint (D grades, 2 bends), standard (A grades, 4 bends), middle (B grades, a longer 4-bend trip), stay (S grades, 6 bends), marathon (M grades, 8 bends) and hurdle (H grades, over hurdles). Leave a kind out and the track doesn't stage those races. Every track needs a standard distance. nights = the nights of the week the track races (Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun). goingBase = how slow the sand usually rides (0 is normal, + is slower, - is faster; a day's going is this plus a random amount). stands = the grandstands along the home straight, in order, repeated along the track (names from "stands" in assets/manifest.json: standard_a, standard_b, heritage, premium, terrace, pavilion, tournament). On competition nights the tournament stand is added too. Add a track by copying a whole { ... } block. The id must be unique and have no spaces.
